name: web-photo-testimonial-card-stack-with-round-arrow-buttons
title: Stacked rounded photo cards with the front portrait sharp, beside a name, role, quote and two black circular arrows
whatItIs: A pale lilac-grey field with a stack of rounded photo cards behind a front portrait of a woman in dark light, and at the right a bold name 'Tamar Mendelson', a grey role, a paragraph review and two black circular arrow buttons.
whatItMeans: Personal and polished; a stack of photos suggests more voices behind the first.
techniques: Offset background photo cards behind the front one.
Pair a large portrait with a bold name.

vocabulary.definition: Black circles with left and right arrows.
A bold name with a lighter title.
The active image at the top of a stack.
